title: AICTEIndividualComplaint
description: Standardized schema for individual institutional complaint records in NyayaNiti

complaint_id.description: Authoritative AICTE statutory reference number (e.g., AICTE-RB-2024-0101, AICTE-PGRC-2026-1021)

complaint_title.description: Formal subject summary or short description of the grievance

complaint_description.description: Substantive narrative of the institutional complaint allegation

institution_id.description: Foreign key reference to AICTE verified technical institution

submission_date.description: ISO 8601 statutory submission or receipt timestamp

institution_name.description: Official registered name of the technical institution

status.description: Current lifecycle status of the complaint
